options.description: The base DN of the tree to start the group search (will do a subtree search from here)

options.name: groupSearchCustomFilter
options.description: For use with the CustomFilter Search type

options.name: groupSearchType
options.description: Controls the default group search filter used

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the SolidFire cluster. For na_elementsw_cluster, the Management IP (MIP) or hostname of the node to initiate the cluster creation from.

options.name: searchBindDN

options.name: searchBindPassword
options.description: The password for the searchBindDN account used for searching

options.name: serverURIs

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the specified volume should exist or not.

options.name: userDNTemplate
